answer: Every new identity gets a haven account whose work is split into sealed threads. The newcomer completes 10 graded tasks, each sealed with a cipher from its task history. Established peers audit random threads by checking the seals, never reading the work. If two identities' threads share one cipher key, both accounts are exposed as one operator and their stakes burn. A clean haven account earns full weight after 3 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes takes 10,000 graded tasks, 3,333 hours at 20 minutes each, plus $25,000 in burned stakes. Like a safe that only opens for the hand that locked it.
